title: senna coronilloides
intro: Senna coronilloides, commonly known as Peruvian senna, is a plant species in the legume family, used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Senna coronilloides include its ability to act as a natural laxative, helping to relieve constipation and promote digestive health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its purgative and anthelmintic properties, which help to expel worms and parasites from the body. The bioactive constituents of Senna coronilloides include sennosides, anthraquinones, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
